description: Notification sent to a newly enrolled student listing the module chat rooms they have been automatically joined to.
subject: You've been added to your module chat rooms
body:
Hello $first_name $last_name,

Welcome to the University. You have been enrolled on $module_count module(s), and we've automatically added you to the matching module chat rooms so you can start talking to your classmates and teaching staff straight away.

Your module chat rooms:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
$rooms_list
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What to do next:
• Sign in with your student credentials.
• Open the Communications dashboard and choose "My Chat Rooms" — each room above will already be listed.
• Introduce yourself, ask questions, and check in regularly for module announcements.

If a room is missing, or you believe you've been added to a room you shouldn't be in, please reply to your module leader or contact the IT helpdesk.

Kind regards,
University Communications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
